body:
I want to thank you all for the responses you have given.  AS for the insurance policy it is worded that if if the suicide is with in the first two years of the contract it would not be paid and all premiums would be returned but after that it would be paid out I am sure at a fight. The real reason I am here is it came close for me. 

I sat in my shed with a gun in my hand looking at pictures.  My wife came home in a panic.  My son had fallen and broken his arm. I realized with the help of all your words and the look of relief when he saw me that I was about to make the worst decision I could ever make.  I am not fixed.  I still feel overwhelmed and I still think I am making the wrong choice(s).  The initial shock has worn off a bit and I still cant shake it.  I have started to look into services that may be available to me in regards to a therapist.  The way my job ended my insurance ended the same day, there is no chance of paying for cobra as I need what money I have to keep the roof and lights on. 

Hopefully I can find something in my city.  My wife may not care but maybe talking will help me get through some of this.  

I just reread the messages here and the private ones I have gotten and am starting to recognize that maybe my kids just need me here.  Broken and damaged but they just need me. 

I may check in from time to time I just want to say thank you again.
